web-guide-idea-78.audience: Home cooks preparing a festival sweet.
web-guide-idea-78.offer: Offer a cook-along centred on texture and timing, the parts that often need live explanation.
web-guide-idea-78.steps.2: Compare results and discuss common adjustments.

web-guide-idea-78.promotion: Use a photo of your actual example and clearly state the skill level.
